native_relation: Each pipeline set position refers either to the active bound resources or to an empty placeholder needed only to preserve set numbering.
transition_kind: logical descriptor sets to native pipeline layout
validity_obligation: Placeholder set layouts preserve numbering without claiming active bindings or a second push-descriptor role.
root_cause: BuiltinExecutables created every placeholder with binding count one, and native layout creation enabled the push-descriptor flag independently of whether a set had real bindings.
physical_effect: VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo contains more than one set layout marked VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR.
consequence: Vulkan validation rejects the pipeline layout; on the reported AMD path no dispatch executes and dependent output is invalid.
repair: PR 10448 creates dummy layouts with zero bindings and enables the push-descriptor flag only when a layout contains at least one binding.

native_relation: The task poller binds an execution wait to its list membership until completion retirement.
validity_obligation: The poller removes every poller-owned reference before retirement publishes completion to the task owner.
root_cause: The old poller retired the wait task before removing it from the poller's working set and wait list.
physical_effect: The poller dereferences task memory after the owner has reclaimed the stack-resident task.
consequence: AddressSanitizer reports a stack-use-after-return in iree_task_list_erase.
repair: PR 11352 returns the retire status to the caller, erases the task from the wait list, retires it afterward, and clears the now-invalid local pointer.

native_relation: The caching allocator binds a logical parameter and initial_data to a free-pool HAL buffer.
validity_obligation: When the caller supplies initial_data, reuse writes those bytes successfully before publishing the buffer.
root_cause: The old caching allocator treated a matching reusable allocation as initialized even when initial_data was supplied.
physical_effect: Execution reads stale parameter bytes through a current logical binding.
consequence: Repeated set_params calls exchange parameter values and produce wrong numerical output.
repair: Commit 7be84611 writes initial_data into an existing buffer, checks the write status, and returns the buffer only after successful initialization.

native_relation: A binding number and byte offset jointly identify the physical subspan passed to each microkernel argument.
validity_obligation: Lowering a binding subspan preserves both its binding identity and byte offset in the descriptor consumed by the microkernel.
root_cause: The memref representation treated a nonzero binding-subspan offset as if the memref began at offset zero on a backend without pointer-arithmetic lowering.
physical_effect: Pointer extraction collapses distinct subspans onto the same base address.
consequence: mmt4d is called with the LHS pointer for RHS and output, causing the matmul tests to fail.
repair: PR 12510 represents nonzero subspan offsets in strided memref metadata, preserves them during flattening, wires the passes into affected backends, and adds offset-sensitive tests.

native_relation: The bytecode dispatcher binds encoded register ordinals to storage in the current VM stack frame.
transition_kind: native import return to bytecode operand read
validity_obligation: After any call that can grow the VM stack, dispatch refreshes the current frame, register pointers, and program counter before decoding the next instruction.
root_cause: The variadic-import path resumed dispatch without refreshing its cached register pointers.
physical_effect: The following conditional branch reads a stale integer slot instead of the zero returned by hal.fence.await.
consequence: A successful fence wait is reported as 'failed to wait on timepoint' on Vulkan and CUDA executions of the UNet model.
repair: PR 12809 restores regs_i32, regs_ref, and pc after every bytecode or import call that may have changed the stack.

native_relation: The tensor-core strategy binds loop iterations, async copies, shared-memory stages, and mma.sync consumers.
validity_obligation: Pipelining proceeds only when the schedule contains the required copies, waits, barriers, warp operations, and stage-separated buffers.
root_cause: The old strategy allowed a pipeline schedule after multibuffering failed to separate every participating shared-memory operand.
physical_effect: A later iteration overwrites a tile before the corresponding mma.sync consumes it.
consequence: The reported matmul returns values short by 16 times pipeline_depth minus one, including 2012 instead of 2044.
repair: PR 13971 makes the mma.sync schedule explicit, rejects incomplete scheduling ingredients, strengthens strategy validation, and adds conservative size and depth guards.

native_relation: IREE HAL buffer views refer to logical buffers that can be subspans of concrete WebGPU allocations.
transition_kind: logical subspan to physical allocation and native-handle transfer
validity_obligation: Native-handle access and transfer submission use the allocated buffer object, while logical range selection preserves the subspan byte offset and length.
root_cause: iree_hal_webgpu_buffer_handle and process_call_outputs used the logical subspan object where the concrete allocated buffer was required.
physical_effect: The runtime obtains an invalid WGPUBuffer handle and submits the output copy against an object whose concrete representation does not match the WebGPU buffer cast.
consequence: The multi-output program reaches a WebGPU handle assertion; AddressSanitizer reports a four-byte out-of-bounds read during transfer-command creation.
repair: PR 14163 resolves a HAL buffer through iree_hal_buffer_allocated_buffer before casting it or placing it in a transfer command, retains the original subspan offset, resets the mapped readback offset to zero, and propagates asynchronous mapping errors.

native_relation: LLVMCPU linking binds generated math calls to embedded or externally supplied implementations.
transition_kind: IR operation to linked runtime symbol
validity_obligation: Embedded builtin modules participate in IR linking only when the embedded-link option is enabled.
root_cause: LLVMCPUTarget linked the musl module independently of the user's linkEmbedded setting.
physical_effect: Calls bind to an empty fmaf body and execution falls into invalid floating-point behavior.
consequence: The softmax produces incorrect output after the math path returns NaN on RV32.
repair: PR 14246 places musl bitcode linking under options_.linkEmbedded, leaving those symbols for the external static link when the option is false.

native_relation: HAL buffer views bind tensor shape and type metadata to a byte range of a backing buffer.
validity_obligation: The accessor can be replaced by the source buffer only when the constructed view starts at offset zero.
root_cause: The old canonicalization treated common source-buffer identity as sufficient and discarded a nonzero view offset.
physical_effect: Both dispatch bindings address the first 64 bytes instead of distinct left and right matrix ranges.
consequence: The matmul computes lhs multiplied by lhs and returns the corresponding wrong tensor values.
repair: PR 14232 restricts the fold to a source offset matched by m_Zero and adds a nonzero-offset no-fold regression.

consequence_tags: wrong result; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: VM register allocation binds multiword SSA values and branch remaps to i32 register-bank slots.
validity_obligation: Multiword remaps reserve one scratch register for each emitted 32-bit word, and bytecode verification bounds-checks every remap ordinal.
root_cause: RegisterAllocation counted a >4-byte remapping as one scratch slot even though bytecode dispatch performs two 32-bit moves.
physical_effect: Branch remapping clears or replaces the low 32 bits of a live HAL buffer reference.
consequence: The corrupted pointer produces a descriptor-binding error, heap-buffer-overflow, or segmentation fault.
repair: PR 14332 reserves ceil(bitwidth/32) scratch registers for multiword remaps; PR 17829 makes IREE_VM_VERIFY_REG_ANY reject out-of-range i32 and ref ordinals.

native_relation: Dispatch result position implicitly determines its associated read-write resource position.
transition_kind: dispatch result position to destination storage
validity_obligation: Transformations preserve the positional association between every dispatch result and its destination resource.
root_cause: EmplaceAllocations allowed non-prefix sparse emplacement even though the downstream representation relies on implicit ordering.
physical_effect: The two computed results are written into each other's destination storage.
consequence: The two-result reproducer returns incorrect tensor values; the reporter confirms correct output after the workaround.
repair: The pass stops emplacement at the first unemplaceable result, preserving a contiguous result prefix.

native_relation: Arith-to-SPIR-V conversion binds a logical sub-byte integer to a wider legal SPIR-V carrier and its extension semantics.
validity_obligation: Unsigned extension zeroes bits above the logical width; signed extension propagates only the logical sign bit; truncation discards all higher carrier bits.
root_cause: The conversion treated equal converted carrier types as if no semantic extension or truncation remained necessary.
physical_effect: i4 values 8 through 15 are represented with incorrect wider integer bits before uitofp.
consequence: The Vulkan result differs from the expected unsigned 0-through-15 sequence.
repair: LLVM commit 2b066501 adds masking and logical/arithmetic shifts for emulated integer extension and truncation. Commit 69a3c9cd permits sub-byte vector conversion. IREE PR 14652 imports them and adds the reported ui4-to-f32 end-to-end regression.

native_relation: IREE bufferization binds HAL binding byte offsets to memref element offsets for packed tensor elements.
validity_obligation: Byte-to-element conversion preserves the physical bit address for sub-byte element types.
root_cause: Bufferization rounded i4 to one byte before converting the offset, losing the packing factor of two.
physical_effect: Loads and reshapes read packed nibbles from the wrong physical positions.
consequence: The sub-byte global produces incorrect numeric results on the LLVM CPU path.
repair: PR 14647 computes (byte_offset * 8) floor-divided by the exact type bit width, extends bit-width handling to vectors, and checks that 64 bytes becomes memref offset 128 for i4.

native_relation: The ROCm HAL binds a user-visible UUID path to a HIP device and its execution context.
transition_kind: external placement identity to physical execution context
validity_obligation: Enumeration, path parsing, HAL IDs, HIP ordinals, and context creation preserve one device identity end to end.
root_cause: The ROCm driver lacked a supported UUID path and a consistent conversion between the default HAL sentinel and zero-based HIP ordinals.
physical_effect: Commands submitted through the selected HAL device execute in the default GPU's primary context.
consequence: Selecting the fourth GPU by UUID still creates and uses device zero.
repair: PR 15234 publishes GPU UUID paths, parses UUID and index paths, introduces explicit HIP-to-HAL ID conversions, and retains then sets the selected device's primary context.

native_relation: queue_copy binds a source byte range to capacity in a destination HAL buffer.
validity_obligation: The copy guard checks source_length less than or equal to target_capacity; it rejects only overflow.
root_cause: queue_copy treated equal backing-buffer lengths as necessary for a full-source copy.
physical_effect: No transfer is submitted for a valid sub-four-byte tensor.
consequence: to_host raises ValueError for a tensor containing one f16 element.
repair: PR 15511 changes the equality check to source_length > target_length and adds tests for smaller-source success and larger-source rejection.

consequence_tags: memory safety; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: pending_queue_actions binds an action's lifetime across worker execution and CUDA/HIP host callbacks.
validity_obligation: Shutdown waits for pending_action_count to reach zero, and callback enqueue wakes the worker.
root_cause: Worker liveness tracked only immediately visible ready work, not actions executing through host callbacks.
physical_effect: The callback accesses queue/action state after the worker's lifecycle decision or leaves new work unprocessed.
consequence: NCCL collectives report CUDA operation-not-permitted errors and may segfault.
repair: PR 16621 counts pending actions until cleanup, posts the state notification from callbacks, delays worker exit until the count is zero, and mirrors the protocol in HIP.

native_relation: The VM register allocator binds typed SSA references and live intervals to encoded physical register ordinals.
transition_kind: SSA reference allocation, liveness release, and physical register reuse
validity_obligation: Register release decodes the full ordinal range defined by the current integer or reference register bank.
root_cause: The release path retained masks from the earlier 8-bit register encoding after register numbers expanded to 16 bits.
physical_effect: The allocator reuses a physical reference-register slot whose prior value is still live, replacing one HAL reference with another reference type.
consequence: ResNet50 execution reaches hal.allocator.allocate.const with a hal.buffer in the register where a hal.allocator is required and fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT.
repair: Commit b0adcaf replaces the 0x3F and 0x7F release masks with kRefRegisterCount and kIntRegisterCount, matching the expanded register banks.

native_relation: The update connects the computed value to an externally supplied target that may be tied to another value.
validity_obligation: An update may be folded only when replacing the target cannot discard an externally observable alias or tied binding.
root_cause: The folder used type/extent equality as sufficient evidence for folding without proving value semantics.
physical_effect: The caller-provided output buffer is not updated through the required resource path.
consequence: The minimal invocation segfaults before the fix; the reporter confirms it works with the fix.
repair: The fold now requires hasValueSemantics(target), excluding external, tied, and subview resources.

native_relation: hal.tensor.alias binds a logical tensor value to caller-provided HAL storage.
validity_obligation: Aliasing intent enters the use-def and allocation chain before a physical transfer is selected.
root_cause: hal.tensor.export encoded output storage as a copy destination instead of an explicit tensor-storage alias.
physical_effect: Lowering emits a copy_buffer operation whose source and target overlap.
consequence: Runtime command-buffer validation rejects the invocation with INVALID_ARGUMENT.
repair: PR 17339 introduces hal.tensor.alias, moves output-storage binding before export, and lowers the alias through import, update, slice, and transfer operations.

native_relation: flow.tensor.transfer and the following tensor.cast carry shape identity from a Turbine tensor into an IREE convolution dispatch and its memref subviews.
validity_obligation: Rank reduction preserves the source-to-result dimension mapping used by every subsequent load.
root_cause: The FoldMemRefAlias path selected a dropped dimension from ambiguous dynamic stride information.
physical_effect: Convolution vector loads advance a spatial coordinate where the channel coordinate should advance.
consequence: The convolution returns incorrect numerical results on the isolated CPU dispatch; the static-shaped variant is correct.
repair: Turbine PR 205 specializes all input and output dimensions when generating flow.tensor.transfer, preventing this path from introducing the ambiguous dynamic-shaped subview.

native_relation: TileDispatchUsingForall binds tensor producers and consumers to yielded tiled-loop values and workgroup distribution.
validity_obligation: Yield selection accounts for the number and compatibility of tilable consumers and revisits producer opportunities after consumer fusion.
root_cause: TileDispatchUsingForall yielded a replacement for a value with multiple tilable consumers.
physical_effect: Part of the dispatch remains undistributed and executes with an incorrect workgroup-to-tensor mapping.
consequence: The LLVMGPU softmax dispatch returns incorrect numerical results.
repair: PR 19212 declines yielded replacement when a fused value has multiple tilable consumers, queues fusion work, and performs another producer-fusion pass with a softmax-shaped regression.

native_relation: PJRT compilation binds a loaded executable to the devices selected in CompileOptionsProto.
validity_obligation: Compilation preserves the selected device assignment in the loaded executable's execution-device list.
root_cause: PJRT_Client_Compile discarded its compile-options device assignment and unconditionally attached addressable_devices_.
physical_effect: JAX derives a four-shard execution requirement from an executable compiled for one assigned device.
consequence: execute_sharded_on_local_devices rejects one argument shard because it expects four.
repair: PR 19369 parses CompileOptionsProto, reads executable_build_options.device_assignment, selects those addressable devices, and passes that list to LoadedExecutableInstance.

native_relation: The selected lowering pipeline binds one logical sort operation to a workgroup execution configuration.
transition_kind: logical sort to workgroup execution mapping
validity_obligation: A multi-thread execution mapping assigns nonconflicting work or introduces synchronization sufficient for shared accesses.
root_cause: The kernel configuration selected LLVMGPUDistribute for SortOp although that path did not distribute the operation.
physical_effect: Multiple workgroup threads race on the same memory locations.
consequence: Sort tests intermittently return different and incorrect tensor contents.
repair: SortOp is configured for LLVMGPUTileAndFuse with sort-specific tiling and workgroup-count handling instead of LLVMGPUDistribute.

native_relation: Corresponding input and filter reduction dimensions must occupy the same positions in the flattened matrix-multiplication K dimension.
transition_kind: convolution coordinates to flattened reduction layout
validity_obligation: Convolution lowering preserves the one-to-one correspondence and order of input and filter reduction coordinates in the flattened K dimension.
root_cause: The im2col representation recorded positions and strides but omitted the permutation from input shared-dimension order to filter shared-dimension order.
physical_effect: Each flattened input element is multiplied by a filter element from a different logical reduction coordinate.
consequence: The reported one-dimensional convolution returns 3 and 4 where the corresponding correct values are 5 and 6; CPU lowering remains correct.
repair: PR 20531 adds and verifies input_filter_perm, derives it from the two indexing maps, and applies it when constructing the im2col K basis; tests include the reported NHC/CHF permutation.

native_relation: The HIP ExportDef binds compiled kernel code to the launch-time dynamic shared-memory amount.
validity_obligation: Compiler and runtime agree on launch-resource fields, or the loader rejects an artifact whose nonzero requirement it cannot honor.
root_cause: The runtime deprecated and ignored the field without rejecting older artifacts that still carried a nonzero value.
physical_effect: The HIP launch provides no dynamically allocated shared memory to a kernel compiled to use it.
consequence: Flux execution completes with empty or garbage output instead of raising a compatibility error.
repair: PR 21118 restores access to the serialized field and rejects any nonzero value with a compiler/runtime-version diagnostic.

native_relation: HLO reduce_window binds a logical init operand to each Linalg output-buffer accumulator.
validity_obligation: Buffer initialization preserves the reduce_window init operand before window elements are combined.
root_cause: The lowering hard-coded zero as the result-buffer initializer instead of reading the operation's init operand.
physical_effect: The minimum reduction retains zero for every output window.
consequence: Both LLVM and Vulkan backends return an all-zero 2x2 tensor instead of values 1, 4, 13, and 16.
repair: PR 4911 extracts a constant init value or loads a dynamic init buffer, fills the result with that value, and adds constant and argument-backed initialization tests.

native_relation: The HIP file-transfer path binds parameter-file chunks to byte ranges in a reusable staging buffer and queued device transfers.
transition_kind: host staging reuse to asynchronous device transfer
validity_obligation: A staging-buffer region is not reused until every transfer reading that region has completed.
root_cause: The circular upload path admitted continued reuse without establishing region-specific completion for the bytes selected next.
physical_effect: Bytes used by queued parameter transfers can be replaced by later file chunks.
consequence: Very large models receive corrupted parameters and exhibit nondeterministic execution.
repair: PR 21758 changes admission from enough free bytes for one chunk to the entire transfer buffer being free, disabling overlapping circular-buffer reuse.

native_relation: IREE binds a logical tensor extent to a concrete stack allocation through value bounds and byte-size resource checks.
transition_kind: value bound to physical allocation size
validity_obligation: Allocation-size products, alignment, and cumulative totals either remain exact and within the limit or stop compilation with a diagnostic.
root_cause: LLVMCPUCheckIRBeforeLLVMConversion accepted a wrapped allocation size as a valid bounded stack allocation.
physical_effect: Generated loads and stores derive from an llvm.alloca poison pointer rather than storage for the logical intermediate tensor.
consequence: Dynamic inner-tiled CPU models compile without a diagnostic and can silently lose accumulator values or return otherwise incorrect results.
repair: PR 24745 computes shaped sizes, dynamic-bound products, alignment, and cumulative allocation totals with 64-bit overflow checks and emits an error when any calculation overflows.

native_relation: VM result packing binds returned references to caller-frame reference registers.
validity_obligation: Reference-register replacement preserves the old identity until the VM reference operation can release or transfer it.
root_cause: The old result-pack variants zeroed opaque_ref, ref<T>, and optional<ref<T>> slots before managed assignment.
physical_effect: The displaced input buffer retains an unbalanced reference count.
consequence: The unused-input program leaves a buffer allocated at shutdown and Vulkan reports the outstanding allocation.
repair: Commit 15e51a85 removes the pre-assignment memset from reference result-pack variants and adds an unused-arguments regression.

native_relation: A CUDA ExportDef binds one logical IREE executable export name to one sanitized PTX kernel symbol and loaded CUfunction.
validity_obligation: Backend symbol sanitization changes only the physical kernel identifier; it preserves an explicit mapping from the unchanged logical export name to that identifier.
root_cause: CUDA serialization reused the sanitized backend symbol as the logical export identity, collapsing two names with different naming rules into one field.
physical_effect: The runtime's direct export-name comparison could not resolve the requested function even though the compiled PTX kernel was present.
consequence: iree-run-module failed with `NOT_FOUND; function 'callee$async_dispatch_0_elementwise_4_f32' not found in executable`, while the CPU backend ran the same module.
repair: PR 24889 appends an optional export_name field to the CUDA executable schema, serializes the original IREE name there, keeps the sanitized kernel_name for cuModuleGetFunction, and stores export_name in the runtime lookup table. New runtimes fall back to kernel_name for older VMFBs.

native_relation: DispatchABI binds a processor-data temporary to an LLVM stack slot and a program point in the generated function.
validity_obligation: Function-lifetime scratch storage is allocated once outside loops, and loop-local code performs only bounded updates.
root_cause: DispatchABI constructed the processor-data allocation at the caller's current insertion point without separating storage reservation from per-call feature patching.
physical_effect: Stack consumption grows linearly with the matmul tile count.
consequence: Large matmuls overflow the worker stack and crash, while small matrices complete.
repair: PR 24749 moves construction to the function entry block. PR 24786 refines the change: only the alloca is hoisted, while feature-bit stores remain at the call site so inlined microkernel checks still devirtualize. Both include IR checks for loop placement.

consequence_tags: hang or deadlock; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: The Vulkan logical device binds an abstract HAL transfer to a queue lane and a concrete command implementation.
validity_obligation: Queue capability selection includes compute for transfer operations that may take the unaligned emulation path.
root_cause: The old logical-device code selected the queue from the abstract transfer category without the concrete replay path's compute requirement.
physical_effect: Vulkan rejects or drops the invalid command while a signal semaphore remains unsatisfied.
consequence: Validation reports errors and the host-to-device transfer hangs indefinitely.
repair: PR 24838 requires both transfer and compute flags for fill/update selection and retries with any affinity when the requested lanes cannot satisfy them.

consequence_tags: resource leak or exhaustion; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: The benchmark input VM list owns tensor buffers allocated by the active HAL session.
validity_obligation: Objects owning session-allocated buffers release those references before session teardown.
root_cause: iree-benchmark-module relied on scope destruction order that kept inputs alive beyond the session.
physical_effect: Vulkan Memory Allocator observes a nonempty allocation block during destruction.
consequence: The benchmark aborts with 'Some allocations were not freed before destruction of this memory block.'
repair: PR 3004 explicitly resets inputs before closing the session and adds the reported Vulkan benchmark command as a regression, later marked for the separate SwiftShader failure.

consequence_tags: resource leak or exhaustion; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: The VM calling convention and result list bind callee reference registers to caller-owned list elements.
validity_obligation: VM list truncation releases owned references, and call transfer semantics move or retain each reference exactly once.
root_cause: The return calling convention and iree_vm_list_resize path did not implement matched ownership transfer and destruction for reference elements.
physical_effect: Device and host allocations accumulate across benchmark repetitions.
consequence: Repeated execution reaches VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY; reducing repetitions only delays it.
repair: PR 4858 implements reference-aware VM list resize/truncation, switches ref return handling to move semantics where appropriate, resets benchmark outputs, and adds resize tests for refs and variants.

native_relation: IREE HAL binding identifiers are mapped by compiler and runtime code to the dense argument ABI of a CUDA kernel launch.
transition_kind: symbolic binding compression across compiler and runtime
validity_obligation: Every participating layer uses one bijection from symbolic binding identifiers to dense kernel-argument positions; the mapping is independent of identifier density and descriptor enumeration order.
root_cause: The lowering and runtime equated a symbolic binding number with a dense array index without establishing that the binding set was dense and ordered.
physical_effect: The generated function or CUDA launch selected an absent or incorrect argument slot, which supplied the wrong device pointer or accessed storage outside the argument array.
consequence: The report records out-of-bounds accesses and heap corruption when bindings were not a dense ordered set.
repair: Commit 0dbd1ac collects binding identifiers, sorts them, and maps them to dense argument positions during lowering. The CUDA command buffer independently sorts descriptor bindings by identifier and writes their device pointers to consecutive argument slots. The compiler regression uses out-of-order sparse identifiers 4, 0, and 7 with distinct element types to check the resulting argument order.

native_relation: The SIP ABI binds VM result slots to Python tuple leaves.
validity_obligation: ABI decoding uses the same zero-based result identity in SIP metadata, VM storage, and the Python sequence.
root_cause: The Python function ABI applied an off-by-one offset when retrieving result values.
physical_effect: Returned tensor handles bind to the wrong Python positions or no position.
consequence: Tuples such as (1,2,3) are returned as sequences containing None and missing values.
repair: PR 5347 corrects result retrieval to outputs->Get(ordinal), normalizes ABI sequences to tuples, and adds tuple lengths zero through three plus nested pytree tests.

native_relation: FuseGlobals maps multiple logical mutable globals into one physical resource and offset layout.
validity_obligation: Fusion requires mutual, path-consistent correlation for every member of an equivalence class.
root_cause: One-way co-occurrence was accepted as an equivalence relation.
physical_effect: Later reads use offsets in a fused allocation whose logical contents no longer match the separate globals.
consequence: Stateful calls produce variable values and an out-of-range copy at offset 64 in a 48-byte buffer.
repair: PR 8008 intersects each candidate correlation set with every member's correlation set and clears candidates that are not self-correlated; it adds an asymmetric-store regression.

native_relation: The load/store offsets and strides identify the physical source and destination regions represented by each tensor slice.
validity_obligation: A destructive-update rewrite preserves the physical region denoted by every source and destination slice.
root_cause: The rewrite constructed replacement slice operations without folding the load/store offsets and strides into their access descriptors.
physical_effect: The select reads a different section of the parent buffer from the section named by the source slice.
consequence: The two output rows are shifted to values from the preceding input rows instead of the expected slices.
repair: PR 8793 folds the dispatch load/store offsets and strides into the replacement extract_slice and insert_slice operations and adds offset, stride, and rank-reduction tests.

native_relation: IREE binds a HAL executable entry point and workload to a workgroup-count region consumed as the runtime dispatch grid.
validity_obligation: The workgroup-count transformation is applied directly to the executable variant and returns failure when it cannot populate the entry-point region.
root_cause: The pipeline treated successful pass-manager invocation as proof that a pass anchored on the special root had executed.
physical_effect: The runtime reaches a dispatch without a defined mapping from workload dimensions to workgroup counts.
consequence: The reported execution exhibits undefined, run-varying thread counts and flaky single-thread results.
repair: Commit 1b9e84c extracts setNumWorkgroupsImpl as a directly callable function, adds iree_set_num_workgroups_to_one to the transform dialect, invokes the implementation on the top-level HAL executable variant, and removes the unreliable nested pass path.

native_relation: The task executor binds worker-thread lifetimes to mutually accessible worker and poller state.
validity_obligation: Shutdown requests all exits, joins every worker and the poller, and only then deinitializes shared worker structures.
root_cause: Executor teardown combined join and deinitialization per worker instead of separating global thread exit from data-structure destruction.
physical_effect: A worker reads peer state concurrently with destruction of that state.
consequence: ThreadSanitizer reports a race between iree_task_worker_try_steal_task and iree_task_executor_destroy.
repair: PR 8873 splits request, await-exit, and deinitialize operations; the executor requests all exits, joins all workers and the poller, then deinitializes them.

native_relation: IREE binds a condition predicate to an event-count token that coordinates producer posts with pthread wait commitment.
transition_kind: completion state to notification token and wait
validity_obligation: Prepare, condition check, and commit use a monotonic notification token so a post in the check-to-wait interval cancels the sleep.
root_cause: The pthread implementation signaled a condition variable but did not maintain the event-count epoch used by the notification contract.
physical_effect: The main thread waits indefinitely after the worker has exited and entered zombie state.
consequence: The dylib test intermittently hangs during iree_task_worker_deinitialize, roughly once per thousand repeated runs.
repair: PR 8877 gives the pthread path a mutex-protected epoch and waiter count; prepare snapshots the epoch, post increments it, and commit waits only while the epoch still equals the captured token.

native_relation: A HAL buffer stores the allocator used later to deallocate its storage.
validity_obligation: The backing allocator remains alive until every buffer that uses it has completed destruction.
root_cause: Returning from iree_hal_buffer_initialize leaves the allocator pointer stored without acquiring the reference required through buffer destruction.
physical_effect: Later buffer destruction dereferences allocator state that has already been freed.
consequence: ASan reports a heap use-after-free and the minimal script segfaults during teardown across multiple drivers.
repair: Buffer initialization retains the device allocator, and buffer destruction releases it after deallocation.

native_relation: MHLOToLinalgOnTensors relates an MHLO public tensor type to its signless internal tensor and returned public tensor type.
validity_obligation: Internal sign erasure does not erase signedness that remains observable at an external function boundary.
root_cause: The conversion target required signless integer types for func.func inputs, results, and returns instead of preserving the public unsigned boundary.
physical_effect: The exported element type identifies the result as generic INT_32, which the Python binding decodes as signed int32.
consequence: The reported sort computes correct bits but returns a signed array unless the result is manually bitcast to uint32.
repair: PR 13090 keeps unsigned types legal at public inputs and outputs and inserts explicit tensor.bitcast operations around the signless internal representation; it adds unsigned-boundary conversion tests.

native_relation: A task timepoint binds a multi-wait event to a semaphore across worker resolution and waiter cancellation.
validity_obligation: A cleanup read of callback-mutated state is ordered with the conflicting reset.
root_cause: The old waiter recovered the semaphore identity from the same base subobject that asynchronous resolution resets.
physical_effect: Worker memset and waiter pointer read race on base.semaphore.
consequence: ThreadSanitizer reports a data race in iree_hal_task_semaphore_multi_wait.
repair: Commit d83f4e46 stores a separate semaphore pointer in iree_hal_task_timepoint_t after acquisition and uses it for conditional cancellation.

native_relation: The VM decoder binds compact bytecode addresses to typed host loads under target-platform alignment policy.
validity_obligation: Target policy distinguishes 64-bit alignment requirements from supported narrower unaligned accesses.
root_cause: One alignment flag represented every width and was also unconditionally reset in one configuration path.
physical_effect: The processor raises an alignment fault while decoding ConstI64.
consequence: IREE hardfaults when dispatching a function containing a 64-bit VM operation on Arm bare-metal targets.
repair: PR 9697 preserves an explicitly required alignment policy; PR 9705 adds IREE_MEMORY_ACCESS_ALIGNMENT_REQUIRED_64 and uses bytewise u64/f64 loads and stores on Arm while retaining native narrower accesses.

native_relation: The poller binds an executor exit request to persistent state and a wake notification.
validity_obligation: The poller rechecks the exit state at the wait-commit boundary after any operation that can clear a concurrent wake signal.
root_cause: The old wait commit path could clear an exit wakeup and block without another state check.
physical_effect: The poller never reaches its zombie state and executor teardown waits indefinitely.
consequence: Approximately 0.5 percent of repeated executor tests deadlock during shutdown.
repair: PR 9724 adds a sequentially consistent EXITING check immediately before entering the system wait and returns when shutdown is pending.

native_relation: Inductor ReinterpretView binds logical size, stride, and relative offset to an input tensor's existing storage.
validity_obligation: View lowering composes a new relative offset with the input's established storage offset.
root_cause: The old Inductor reference code discarded an input tensor's existing storage offset when materializing a derived view.
physical_effect: The generated view binds the logical slice to the wrong physical elements of the backing storage.
consequence: All 16 output elements mismatch the eager result for the nonzero-offset input.
repair: PR 108259 introduces _reinterpret_tensor, sets storage_offset to self.storage_offset plus offset_increment, and uses it for generated view and buffer-reuse references.

native_relation: TorchInductor lowers bucketize/searchsorted to a Triton binary search over a named boundary buffer and its view layout.
transition_kind: logical binary-search position to physical strided load
validity_obligation: Every binary-search load applies the lookup tensor's last-dimension stride after selecting the correct boundary set and optional sorter entry.
root_cause: The generated bucketize helper assumed contiguous last-dimension storage for all boundary and sorter tensors.
physical_effect: The binary search compares values against elements outside the logical strided boundary sequence and moves its low and high bounds using those comparisons.
consequence: Compiled bucketize returns results that differ from eager execution for boundaries[::2], while the contiguous control passes.
repair: Commit a968576 extends the bucketize operation with boundary-set indices, storage extent, boundary stride, optional sorter stride, and sorter indices; the Triton helper multiplies midpoint indices by those strides and adds multidimensional, strided, sorted, and searchsorted tests.

native_relation: FlexAttention backward binds higher-order-operation metadata to Inductor intermediate and returned gradient buffers.
transition_kind: input view layout through higher-order backward metadata and gradient storage
validity_obligation: Meta inference, kernel output allocation, batch-head reduction, and returned-gradient layout use compatible shapes and dense nonoverlapping strides with the input's stride order.
root_cause: The backward contract reused raw input strides for differently shaped intermediates and did not distinguish broadcasted gradient storage from final correctly strided outputs.
physical_effect: The fused epilogue races between stores and loads over overlapping regions, so K-gradient values depend on execution and allocation state.
consequence: For noncontiguous K slices, repeated compiled runs produce changing garbage-valued K.grad means; cloning K into contiguous storage makes the result stable.
repair: Commit 69feef5 defines broadcasted K/V gradient shapes explicitly, derives dense nonoverlapping strides that preserve input stride order, copies reduced gradients into correctly strided returned buffers, aligns fake-mode metadata with lowering, and adds strided backward correctness and stride-order tests.

consequence_tags: wrong result; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: TorchInductor binds an FX tensor layout to the contiguous storage consumed by a functional C10d collective.
transition_kind: FX view semantics through compiler layout selection and collective transfer
validity_obligation: Compiler lowering enforces the FX stride contract at collective boundaries, and the native operation rejects inputs that do not satisfy its contiguous-memory requirement.
root_cause: Functional collectives were treated as layout-polymorphic even though their native implementations consumed contiguous storage order.
physical_effect: The all-gather output contains the same storage values in the wrong transposed order, so the following matrix multiplication pairs incorrect elements.
consequence: Compiled w_grad differs at 16,690,833 of 16,777,216 elements, with a maximum absolute error of 422 in the report.
repair: Commit 97f6480 introduces register_comm_lowering, attaches constrain_to_fx_strides to functional collective lowerings, adds native contiguity checks, and includes the report's FP8 rowwise-backward all-gather regression.

native_relation: rms_norm_symint relates a logical RMSNorm result to the backend operation that fills its MPS output tensor.
validity_obligation: Every backend operation selected during capture is visible to dispatcher-based tracing or has an equivalent captured decomposition.
root_cause: The fused MPS implementation was called as an unregistered native helper from rms_norm_symint.
physical_effect: Generated code allocates an MPS output buffer and returns it without launching the RMSNorm kernel.
consequence: The compiled model returns zeros while eager execution returns nonzero normalized values.
repair: PR 150661 registers _rms_norm_fused as an ATen MPS operation, dispatches through it, and makes Inductor fall back on that traceable operator.

native_relation: to_dtype_bitcast binds a logical dtype view to the storage-preserving Triton conversion sequence.
validity_obligation: A same-width dtype view performs a bit reinterpretation at the declared source width, independent of the compiler's compute type.
root_cause: to_dtype_bitcast derived the bitcast decision from upcast compute types instead of first restoring the declared source dtype.
physical_effect: The generated Triton store writes the bfloat16 encoding of numeric 4 rather than uint16 bits 0x0004.
consequence: Compiled execution prints 4.0 where eager bit-level copy yields approximately 3.67e-40.
repair: PR 154121 asserts equal item sizes, casts a promoted value back to src_dtype, performs an unconditional bitcast to dtype, and then reapplies any compute upcast; it adds test_uint_view_copy.

native_relation: TorchInductor routes FX operator calls through lowering paths that either coerce exact strides or directly emit a fallback call.
transition_kind: logical view through operator dispatch and exact-stride materialization
validity_obligation: Opaque custom operators pass through the exact-stride call path regardless of whether their input dtype is supported by ordinary Inductor lowering.
root_cause: The unsupported-type branch classified all operator overloads as built-ins and captured custom-library operations.
physical_effect: The custom implementation indexes a noncontiguous or differently ordered buffer under its contiguous-input assumption.
consequence: Compiled custom-operator execution with float8_e8m0fnu inputs can silently produce incorrect values instead of receiving the contiguous arguments required by the operator.
repair: Commit 657e5e9 restricts the unsupported-type shortcut to built-in operator overloads, sending all custom operators through GraphLowering.call_function, and adds float and float8 tests whose custom implementation asserts the required contiguous layouts.

native_relation: WeakDep relates a read of a mutation target's prior contents to the later mutating write during scheduler fusion.
validity_obligation: A WAR dependency is removed during fusion only when the fused read and write are the same pointwise access over the same extent.
root_cause: _prune_redundant_deps treated a WeakDep as redundant without checking whether fusable_weak_dep proved compatible indices.
physical_effect: Threads overwrite cache elements while other accesses still need their old values, creating a data race in the fused rotation.
consequence: Deterministic model generation produces varying and incorrect completions under torch.compile.
repair: PR 162316 prunes dependencies before each fusion round and retains WeakDeps unless the producer/consumer access is demonstrably pointwise-compatible; it adds an inplace flip regression.

native_relation: TorchInductor scheduler dependencies bind reads and mutations of one storage object to a legal execution order across fused kernels.
transition_kind: dependency-preserving fusion and in-place state update
validity_obligation: A write-after-read dependency is removed only when every relevant read and the mutation access the same buffer positions with compatible iteration domains.
root_cause: _prune_redundant_deps treated the presence of another upstream dependency as sufficient to discard the mutation-ordering edge.
physical_effect: Parallel Triton program instances could overwrite state elements before other instances completed the shifted reads from those elements.
consequence: The compiled function intermittently copied newly inserted rows into earlier state positions, while eager execution retained zeros outside the final two rows.
repair: Commit f34744d checks fusable_weak_dep before pruning a WeakDep, performs dependency pruning before each fusion round, rejects broad StarDep writes, and validates all relevant reads against the mutation's index and size. It adds an in-place flip regression whose read and write indices differ.

native_relation: Inductor binds scheduler dependencies and store modes to the placement of atomic updates and their consumers across generated kernels.
transition_kind: atomic scatter writes through scheduler fusion to dependent read
validity_obligation: An atomic scatter that requires contributions across program instances completes in a separate kernel before any dependent read of its target begins.
root_cause: The fusion check compared read and write indices but did not reject writes whose store mode requires cross-thread synchronization.
physical_effect: The gather observes the zero-filled or partially accumulated target rather than the completed reduction.
consequence: The report's compiled index_add_ model returns a mean near 1,009,876.5 instead of the eager value near 0.000977; the later duplicate returns all-zero gathered rows.
repair: Commit 1687bbf classifies non-default store modes as requiring synchronization and rejects fusion between such writes and dependent reads. It adds CUDA regressions for the reported index_add_ pattern and a second atomic-add/read pattern.

consequence_tags: wrong result; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: Inductor binds symbolic reshape metadata to a ReinterpretView over the original tensor storage.
transition_kind: symbolic reshape metadata to storage-preserving output view
validity_obligation: A metadata-only reshape either computes output strides from the actual input size and stride or materializes/reindexes the tensor when no valid view exists.
root_cause: Dynamic lowering selected contiguous output strides solely from the new shape even though the input storage layout was noncontiguous.
physical_effect: Generated loads use a dense address progression across a physical gap and read unrelated or uninitialized values.
consequence: The compiled reshape-plus-one output differs from eager execution by values on the order of 10^33; making the input contiguous or disabling dynamic shapes avoids the failure.
repair: Commit b337828 converts symbolic sizes and strides to SymInt, applies _compute_stride to the actual input layout, emits a ReinterpretView only when that calculation succeeds, and otherwise uses the dynamic reindex or contiguous-materialization path. It adds the report's empty_strided reshape as a regression.

native_relation: The event synchronization orders host consumption after completion of the device-to-host copies.
transition_kind: asynchronous copy to ordered host consumption
validity_obligation: Every host read of a nonblocking device-to-host destination occurs after a completion event for the producing copy.
root_cause: Event.synchronize was not represented as an ordered effect, and locality reordering could move cross-device device_put operations across synchronization.
physical_effect: The CPU consumer can execute while DMA is still writing its input buffers.
consequence: The compiled host computation can read stale or partially copied values; the report later confirms correct generated output on main.
repair: PR 176878 introduces an ordered synchronize_event operation, lowers it through Inductor, and prevents cross-device nonblocking device_put from moving across synchronization during locality reordering.

native_relation: Inductor binds a scatter's logical iteration variables to a physical write index and uses weak dependencies to decide reader/writer fusion.
transition_kind: non-injective logical-to-physical index mapping followed by mutation
validity_obligation: A scatter writer whose index omits any iteration variable is treated as non-injective and is not fused with a reader of the mutated buffer.
root_cause: The weak-dependency fusion check did not test whether every write-range variable appeared in the scatter's physical index expression.
physical_effect: A later fused iteration reads the value written by an earlier iteration and increments the same destination twice.
consequence: Eager execution writes 1 at the selected position, while compiled execution writes 2.
repair: Commit 67e982d rejects weak-dependency fusion when the write index does not contain every write-range variable. Its regressions cover duplicate-index index_put_ with and without accumulation.

native_relation: Inductor binds logical tensor dtypes to backend compute values and explicit conversion operations inside fused kernels.
transition_kind: logical precision conversion through backend compute-type representation
validity_obligation: When eager-compatible cast emulation is enabled and either endpoint is float16 or bfloat16, lowering performs the low-precision conversion at the logical cast boundary before restoring the compute representation.
root_cause: The lowering propagated the logical result dtype but omitted the physical rounding action required by that dtype's eager semantics.
physical_effect: Bits that eager execution discards at the bfloat16 boundary survive the fused compiled expression.
consequence: The compiled round-trip output is not bitwise equal to eager execution; the generated Triton kernel converts the loaded value only to float32 and stores it unchanged.
repair: Commit 8aa6538 lets to_dtype disable compute-type substitution, selects that mode for float16/bfloat16 conversions under emulate_precision_casts, then restores a compute-type value after the real low-precision conversion. It adds the report's dynamic CUDA round trip as a regression.

native_relation: Inductor binds explicit dtype-transition nodes to optimizer rewrite decisions before those transitions reach kernel lowering.
transition_kind: explicit dtype nodes through joint-graph rewrite to fused computation
validity_obligation: When precision-cast emulation is enabled, elimination requires the first cast to preserve both precision and representable range of its source dtype.
root_cause: The rewrite classified a downcast-then-upcast pair by dtype membership rather than by whether the first conversion loses information.
physical_effect: The fused kernel retains float32 mantissa bits that eager execution discards at the bfloat16 or float16 boundary.
consequence: The compiled bfloat16 example differs from eager by up to 0.109 and closely matches a version with the cast removed; generated code contains no conversion nodes.
repair: Commit 24c273c adds a finfo-based lossless-widening test and blocks pointless_convert when the first cast loses precision or range under emulate_precision_casts. It adds bfloat16 and float16 round-trip regressions that check both output equality and emitted low-precision conversion code.

native_relation: TorchInductor resolves a FlexibleLayout into physical producer and consumer strides while comprehensive padding and user-visible constraints are applied.
transition_kind: logical view and reduction through shared physical layout selection
validity_obligation: All stride decisions for one shared buffer converge on one physical layout before producer and consumer address expressions are emitted.
root_cause: mark_nodes_dislike_padding applied an output-oriented no-padding preference to a reduction whose input layout had already participated in a padded view decision.
physical_effect: For each batch after zero, the reduction skips the first 15 valid elements and reads 15 elements beyond that batch's physical range.
consequence: Batch zero is correct, while later batches silently differ from eager by up to 8.72 in the report's four-batch reproducer.
repair: Commit eb06bf6 excludes reduction-like operations from the user-visible dislike_padding mark because their fresh output strides are already constrained elsewhere, and adds the exact adaptive-pool, flatten, and sum regression with comprehensive padding enabled.

native_relation: PyTorch meta kernels bind functional scatter semantics to the physical size-and-stride contract consumed by Inductor scheduling and code generation.
transition_kind: overlapping view metadata through functional scatter allocation and backward code generation
validity_obligation: A functional scatter materializes its base when the input has internal overlap; only a nonoverlapping base can preserve its strides in result metadata.
root_cause: Fake/meta execution preserved an overlapping view layout that eager clone-and-scatter cannot use for independently writable result positions.
physical_effect: The generated backward kernel writes only 132 unique elements instead of 1,716 and reinterprets them as a size-(4,13,33) zero-stride tensor.
consequence: The forward output and y.grad are correct, but compiled x.grad is entirely zero rather than retaining the upstream gradient outside slice rows 0 through 5.
repair: Commit af24caa detects definite internal overlap in the scatter base and returns self.clone() for materialized result metadata, while retaining clone_preserve_strides for nonoverlapping or symbolically unresolved inputs. It adds the exact backward regression.

native_relation: TorchInductor schedules FX random fallback nodes that advance the process-global CUDA RNG state.
transition_kind: logical program order to physical stateful execution order
validity_obligation: Stateful seeded operations have explicit control dependencies that preserve their program order even when no tensor data dependency connects them.
root_cause: Seeded nondeterministic fallback nodes were modeled as freely reorderable independent computations.
physical_effect: Each tensor receives random values from a different segment of the global CUDA RNG stream than eager execution assigns to it.
consequence: After resetting the seed to 42, eager runs agree with each other but the compiled output differs because Inductor executes the random calls in b, c, a order.
repair: Commit 0aaf395 identifies FX nodes tagged nondeterministic_seeded, chains adjacent nodes through preserve_node_ordering when fallback_random is enabled, supports dependency values with multiple IR leaves, and adds the reported randn/conv2d and tuple-output dropout regressions.

native_relation: The diagonal_scatter decomposition clones an input tensor and mutates the diagonal view of the cloned layout.
transition_kind: overlapping expanded layout to mutable scatter storage
validity_obligation: A scatter decomposition materializes an internally overlapping input before mutating only the selected diagonal positions.
root_cause: clone_preserve_strides was used even when a dimension of size greater than one had stride zero.
physical_effect: Writing the diagonal value changes the shared storage element that represents every non-diagonal position as well.
consequence: Compiled backward produces an all-zero gradient for x, while eager execution produces ones outside the diagonal and zeros on the diagonal.
repair: Commit c004e2d detects size-greater-than-one dimensions with stride zero and uses input.clone to create nonoverlapping contiguous storage before the diagonal mutation; otherwise it retains clone_preserve_strides. It adds an eager-versus-compiled gradient regression.

native_relation: TorchInductor maps a logical lookup TensorBox and its view layout into the buffer name and indices consumed by generated bucketize code.
transition_kind: logical tensor view to generated physical storage index
validity_obligation: Before code generation, the lookup is represented as a named strided tensor and every binary-search base index includes that tensor's layout offset and outer-dimensional stride contribution.
root_cause: The lowering treated a logical lookup view as though its storage began at index zero in a directly queryable named buffer.
physical_effect: One path raises NotImplementedError while requesting a SliceView stride; the other searches the unsliced prefix of the backing buffer and shifts every returned insertion position.
consequence: Compiled searchsorted either crashes for dynamic slices or returns values one position above the eager result for offsets[1:].
repair: Commit f1987e1 realizes lookup tensors through ExternKernel.realize_input, computes binary-search indices from layout.offset and strides, uses the layout storage span for masking, and adds sliced, offset, multidimensional, sorter, zero-stride, and dynamic-shape regressions.

native_relation: Inductor binds an epilogue value expression to a store inside a user-defined Triton kernel.
validity_obligation: A substituted epilogue is unary and pointwise over the output buffer, with identical read and write index expressions and iteration sizes.
root_cause: The fusion check required reads to name the output buffer but did not compare the epilogue's read and write indices.
physical_effect: A value selected through the layout-changing read map is written through a different physical position map.
consequence: The reported fused transpose-contiguous path returns values that differ from the unfused result.
repair: Commit 12b766b permits this fusion only for one read and one write of the output with equal index expressions and sizes. The user-kernel store mode also rejects an unexpected epilogue store, and the commit adds the report's transpose-contiguous regression.

native_relation: The CPU code generator binds a low-precision CSE value to an optional cached inverse conversion and to physical stores.
transition_kind: logical precision change through CPU CSE conversion caching
validity_obligation: A reverse low-precision conversion is cached as lossless only when a physical low-precision store has established that the cached source and reloaded value represent the same rounded data.
root_cause: The CPU code generator populated the reverse conversion cache when it formed an in-register low-precision cast rather than when it stored that value.
physical_effect: Float32 mantissa bits that should be discarded at the float16 boundary remain available to the widening cast.
consequence: The compiled CPU output stays closer to the original float32 input and differs from eager execution's explicitly rounded values.
repair: Commit 33cd17c disables the reverse low-precision-to-float32 cache under emulate_precision_casts in both CPU vector and scalar code paths and adds the report's explicit round-trip regression. The existing store/reload optimization remains available outside emulation.

native_relation: Expansion maps multiple logical elements or rows to the same physical storage locations.
transition_kind: functional indexed write to in-place mutation
validity_obligation: Reinplacement is allowed only when the mutated destination has no definite internal overlap that changes functional semantics.
root_cause: can_inplace checked inter-tensor aliasing but omitted the destination's definite internal-overlap check.
physical_effect: Writes from different expanded rows fold through the same storage locations.
consequence: The compiled gradient is wrong by the batch-size factor on CPU and CUDA.
repair: can_inplace rejects a mutated argument when _debug_has_internal_overlap returns definite overlap; regression tests cover indexed operations.

native_relation: FlexAttention binds logical sparse BlockMask metadata and predicate graphs to FA4 block-sparse tensors and tile traversal.
transition_kind: BlockMask metadata through lowering flags and FA4 sparse traversal
validity_obligation: Block-sparse traversal is selected from the presence of a real BlockMask, while mask_mod generation is controlled separately by the predicate graph.
root_cause: The lowering conflated two independent facts: whether tile metadata restricts traversal and whether a per-element predicate must execute.
physical_effect: FLASH loads and accumulates K/V tiles outside the selected sparse block set.
consequence: Metadata-only FLASH results differ from the dense masked reference by up to 0.258789, while TRITON and FLASH with an equivalent nontrivial mask_mod match the reference.
repair: Commit 164a4b3 skips block-sparse tensors only for FlexAttention's synthetic dense no-op BlockMask, separates HAS_MASK_MOD from NEEDS_BLOCK_MASK, supplies zero full-block tensors when only partial metadata exists, and adds metadata-only FLASH regressions.

native_relation: TorchInductor represents transpose and reshape as composable ReinterpretView index maps over storage.
transition_kind: logical transpose through nested view construction to physical indexing
validity_obligation: Lowering unwraps a TensorBox container but preserves any raw IR view node and its logical-to-physical index map.
root_cause: The view lowering conflated container unwrapping with removal of an existing ReinterpretView.
physical_effect: The generated kernel loads right-operand elements at 4 times k plus x instead of k plus 3 times x.
consequence: Compiled mm on a 64 by 3 matrix and a transposed 4 by 3 matrix has a maximum error around 8 instead of float32-level agreement.
repair: Commit f2a2c90 widens view lowering to raw IRNode inputs, unwraps .data only when the input is a TensorBox, removes the clone workaround from small-mm lowering, and strengthens transposed left, right, and both-operand decomposition tests.

consequence_tags: wrong result; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: TorchInductor tracks stores invalidated across a reduction-loop boundary and emits Triton global loads and stores within one fused GPU kernel.
transition_kind: same-kernel cross-warp store to later reload
validity_obligation: A same-kernel global read-after-write edge that crosses warps is ordered by a barrier before the first reload.
root_cause: The load path did not discharge the read-after-write synchronization obligation tracked by invalidated_stores.
physical_effect: The second loop reads stale or partially written global scratch values and incorporates them into the reduction result.
consequence: The reported pit_b_224 XPU inference fails accuracy with RMSE around 0.4; the second report observes nondeterministic compiled gradients on AMD GPUs.
repair: Commit 62a4f51 emits tl.debug_barrier before a non-CPU load when its buffer name is in cse.invalidated_stores and adds a compiled normalization regression that checks for the barrier and correct output.

native_relation: Inductor binds a requested random tensor size-and-stride layout to the storage allocated and initialized by its uniform decomposition.
transition_kind: requested noncontiguous layout through allocation sizing and as_strided reconstruction
validity_obligation: Before constructing a strided view, the backing allocation length is at least the maximum reachable offset plus one for the requested shape, stride, and storage offset.
root_cause: Allocation size was derived from the product of logical dimensions rather than from the physical span of the target stride mapping.
physical_effect: Some output positions read memory outside the initialized random sample buffer and expose stale or unrelated values.
consequence: Compiled uniform_ returns NaNs and values outside [0,1] in later rows, while eager execution returns valid uniform samples at every view position.
repair: Commit 1005a82 computes the required storage length from output shape and strides, generates a one-dimensional random buffer covering that span, and always reconstructs the requested layout with as_strided. It adds the report's sliced-view range and stride regression.

native_relation: as_strided offsets are relative to the original storage, while a realized intermediate owns only its allocated layout extent.
validity_obligation: Every reinterpreted view over a realized buffer remains within that buffer's allocated extent, or retains the base storage that makes the geometry valid.
root_cause: as_strided lowering accepted a storage-relative offset and span without comparing the required extent with the selected realized allocation.
physical_effect: Generated code performs an unmasked read beyond the realized buffer into freed or unrelated memory.
consequence: The compiled output contains 2,048 allocator-poison values and differs from eager execution.
repair: The repair preserves or clones the appropriate base for mutated views and rejects or guards ReinterpretView extents that exceed non-input allocations.

native_relation: The generated output name denotes a view whose writes must update a region of the shared gradient buffer.
transition_kind: non-owning result to destination alias write
validity_obligation: Code generation for a non-owning output writes through the existing alias instead of rebinding its name to independent storage.
root_cause: _codegen_mix_order_reduction emitted variable assignment for every output layout.
physical_effect: The reduction value stays in standalone storage while the returned shared gradient buffer contains stale or uninitialized bytes in that slice.
consequence: Compiled gradients show relative errors around 1e6 for affected slices.
repair: For NonOwningLayout outputs, code generation emits output_alias.copy_(reduced) and retains assignment only for owning outputs.

native_relation: Inductor binds logical arg-reduction indices to explicit expressions or native physical loop counters across lowering, scheduling, and code generation.
transition_kind: logical index through lowering, loop reordering, cache lookup, and arg-reduction codegen
validity_obligation: The logical index remains an explicit expression through all loop transformations unless a late proof shows that it equals the final native reduction order.
root_cause: Index-elision was decided from an early layout observation that subsequent layout changes and loop reordering could invalidate.
physical_effect: The winning value is paired with its physical loop position rather than its logical row-major position.
consequence: For the reported mean-plus-argmax input, eager returns logical index 12 at the true maximum, while compiled code returns index 24 whose logical value is not maximal; channels-last variants exhibit the same mismatch.
repair: Commit d607816 always carries logical indices for arg reductions through lowering, runs a late pass that removes an index only when it matches the final reduction-variable flattening, and includes retained indices in Triton reduction cache keys. It adds CPU/GPU regressions for fused noncontiguous reductions and cache sharing.

native_relation: TorchInductor binds a ReinterpretView index map to the physical strides chosen for a backing FlexibleLayout.
transition_kind: logical view creation through physical layout finalization
validity_obligation: Creating a persistent physical index map freezes the backing layout that the map encodes before later padding or reuse decisions run.
root_cause: The reshape path allowed a ReinterpretView to retain an index map derived from a mutable FlexibleLayout.
physical_effect: The consumer calculates addresses with strides that no longer describe the producer's physical layout and reads padding or uninitialized storage.
consequence: With comprehensive padding enabled, repeated compiled calls return different wrong values; fp32 differs from eager by about 1.58 and low-precision runs can produce NaNs.
repair: Commit 0ff4b33 removes freeze=False from as_storage_and_layout, freezing the backing layout before deriving the ReinterpretView index map, and adds a nonaligned-width forward-and-backward regression that crosses the padding threshold.

native_relation: Inductor binds functional scatter dataflow to an optional in-place copy over physical tensor storages and views.
transition_kind: functional snapshot semantics through reinplacing to physical overlapping copy
validity_obligation: Scatter reinplacing is allowed only when its source storage is independent of the storage that the mutating decomposition overwrites.
root_cause: The pre-fix in-place safety test considered later uses of `inp` but omitted the comparison between `get_node_storage(inp)` and `get_node_storage(src)`.
physical_effect: CPU iteration propagates row zero through later rows, while concurrent GPU blocks race between source loads and destination stores.
consequence: Large CUDA inputs produce run-dependent wrong elements and CPU inputs deterministically repeat row zero, although eager clone semantics shift each row exactly once.
repair: Commit 0f9fcef obtains the storage identities of the generalized-scatter input and source and declines reinplacing when they match. The functional decomposition then retains its cloned base. It adds the reported row-shift regression on CPU.

native_relation: Reinplacement makes the functional result and graph input share storage.
validity_obligation: If a later write replaces the input with a value unrelated to the reinplaced result, neither the result nor any value that would share its buffer remains observable afterward.
root_cause: The placeholder branch checked for a copy-back and intervening input-view uses but not the copy source or post-copy liveness of the result alias closure.
physical_effect: The later input write replaces bytes that still represent the returned functional result.
consequence: The returned scatter result contains zeros or fill values instead of the eager result.
repair: The pass computes values that would alias the result, checks whether copy_ writes one of them, and rejects reinplacement when an unrelated copy precedes any later use of that alias set.

native_relation: Inductor's mutation versioning binds several graph names to one physical tensor storage while WeakDep constrains fusion around writes.
transition_kind: mutation versioning followed by cross-index in-place update
validity_obligation: Before fusing a reader with a later mutation, read identities are resolved through the mutation chain and differing read/write indices remain ordered across kernels.
root_cause: The dependency check resolved the later mutation to its real buffer but compared each read's unresolved versioned name.
physical_effect: One kernel reads x at reversed positions while writing x, allowing reads to observe elements already changed by other iterations.
consequence: The reported program returns widespread silent value mismatches on CPU and CUDA, including about one million differing elements at shape 1024 by 2048.
repair: Commit 8513bdd resolves every candidate read through mutation_real_name before comparing it with the mutated buffer. It adds the report's index_put_-then-flip regression.

native_relation: Inductor binds functional RNG seed-offset pairs and generated kernel indices to Triton scalar or four-word random primitives.
transition_kind: logical RNG offset through primitive selection and Philox word extraction
validity_obligation: Vectorized random generation is selected only when offset grouping preserves one-to-one logical RNG identity and every recomputation uses the same seed-offset-to-word mapping.
root_cause: The selection rule used generated-kernel dimensionality as a proxy for offset contiguity and did not preserve the RNG mapping across alternative legal tilings.
physical_effect: Groups of channels receive duplicate random words, while checkpoint forward and recompute obtain independent masks from identical functional RNG state.
consequence: Compiled inference shows 100% duplication within four-channel groups, and checkpoint forward/backward mask agreement falls to about 50% at p=0.5, producing silent wrong gradients.
repair: Commit 983d11f adds an explicit use_rand4x configuration gate that is disabled by default and updates random-codegen tests to exercise the safe tl.rand default while retaining opt-in rand4x coverage.

native_relation: Flex decoding binds an Inductor query buffer's physical strides to a fixed GQA reinterpretation and decode-kernel address calculation.
transition_kind: flexible query layout through freezing, GQA reinterpretation, and kernel address calculation
validity_obligation: Lowering freezes a flexible producer's physical layout before exporting its strides into any fixed view or kernel interface.
root_cause: Stride metadata was consumed as a stable physical contract although its owning buffer could still change layout during scheduling.
physical_effect: The decode kernel maps logical q head and sequence coordinates to wrong physical offsets in the realized pointwise buffer.
consequence: For sequence lengths 32 and 64 with a pointwise q/k producer, compiled FlexAttention differs from the matching SDPA result by about 0.90 to 0.96; direct q/k inputs and lengths at least 128 are correct.
repair: Commit 17b697f freezes the realized query through as_storage_and_layout before reading its strides and constructing the GQA view. It adds a short-query pointwise-producer regression for MHA and GQA configurations.

consequence_tags: wrong result; runtime rejection or crash
native_relation: Inductor binds a functional indexed update to an optional mutating operation over physical storages shared by its operands.
transition_kind: functional indexed dataflow through reinplacing to physical mutation
validity_obligation: A functional indexed update becomes in-place only when every index and value operand is storage-independent from the destination input.
root_cause: Liveness of the destination was treated as sufficient for reinplacing, omitting storage dependencies carried by other operands of the same operation.
physical_effect: Accumulated writes change data that later iterations interpret as indices or source values, altering the update set and contributions.
consequence: The reported CPU program is deterministic but differs from eager, including position 9 producing 54 instead of 46; CUDA can reject the overlap.
repair: Commit dd806b6 adds a storage-alias check over all index_put indices, values, and keyword operands and uses it for index_put and unsafe_index_put reinplacing. Aliased cases remain functional; independent operands retain the in-place optimization. It adds the exact torch.put regression and graph-level controls.

native_relation: Each pipelined TMA transaction writes to the shared-memory slice assigned to its stage.
transition_kind: descriptor load to staged TMA address
validity_obligation: Every stage destination selected for a TMA transaction satisfies the required shared-memory alignment.
root_cause: Descriptor-to-TMA selection checked the operation form but not whether the per-stage block size preserves alignment across the ring buffer.
physical_effect: A TMA transaction targets a misaligned shared-memory address.
consequence: Both reported kernels fail at runtime with CUDA_ERROR_MISALIGNED_ADDRESS when num_stages is three.
repair: PR 10898 checks the descriptor load block size against 128-byte alignment, excludes unaligned loads from TMA pipelining, lowers them through the pointer path, and adds runtime and IR regressions.

native_relation: AMD conversion lowering binds an FP8 logical value and bit pattern to FP16/BF16 output bits.
validity_obligation: The format-specific 0x80 case overrides generic zero and sign decoding in every software conversion path.
root_cause: Three software decoders either omitted the 0x80 case or applied it before later operations that clobbered the NaN result.
physical_effect: A special logical value silently becomes a finite value during representation conversion.
consequence: NaN propagation and masking observe -0.0 on non-CDNA3 AMD targets.
repair: PR 10747 places an explicit 0x80-to-NaN select after zero/sign decoding for e4m3fnuz and adds the missing e5m2fnuz and BF16 cases with conversion tests.

native_relation: MMA2 consumes MMA1's result in the same iteration, and MMA1 of the next iteration consumes the accumulator after MMA2 completes.
validity_obligation: Pipeline staging preserves every same-iteration and loop-carried accumulator dependency between chained MMA operations.
root_cause: AssignLatencies treated the chained MMAs as overlap candidates without detecting the accumulator's transfer cycle.
physical_effect: The next iteration reads an accumulator state that omits the second MMA from the preceding iteration.
consequence: Blackwell kernels show deterministic maximum absolute errors around 50 to 70, while single-MMA and separate-accumulator controls are correct.
repair: PR 10858 forwards chained MMAs to one accumulator where valid and detects loop-carried accumulator cycles so their MMA operations receive no movable latency; tests cover shared accumulators and cyclic transfers.

native_relation: WarpGroupDotWaitOp binds pending asynchronous WGMMA results to a synchronization scope over participating warpgroups.
validity_obligation: A wait exposed as CTA-wide inserts cross-warpgroup synchronization when num_warps exceeds four.
root_cause: WarpGroupDotWaitOp did not represent whether its scope was local and lowering omitted a CTA barrier for multi-warpgroup use.
physical_effect: Warpgroups diverge around shared-memory reuse and read different B tiles.
consequence: The exact integer-valued matmul accumulation becomes intermittently incorrect.
repair: PR 11056 adds a warpGroupLocal attribute, emits nvvm.barrier after nonlocal waits when num_warps > 4, teaches membar analysis that such waits synchronize, and adds the reported two-warpgroup regression.

native_relation: The lowered SSA value is related to two physical FP8 stores through Triton layout conversion and ptxas register allocation.
